name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 13 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-05-17, at wavelengths from 1.44 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
